newsitem.title: UK: Management buyouts at record level in 1996 - KPMG.
newsitem.headline: Management buyouts at record level in 1996 - KPMG.

text.p: Management buy-outs hit record levels in Britain in 1996, a survey from the the corporate finance arm of accountants KPMG, released on Monday, showed.
KPMG estimated that the value of buy-outs and buy-ins totalled 6.77 billion stg this year, above the the record figure of 6.70 billion stg set last year.
The total number of deals reached 600, up from the 560 seen last year and the trend looks set to continue through next year.
"Underlying economic conditions and the weight of institutional liquidity point to another good year for MBOs in 1997," Mike Stevens, Head of MBO services at KPMG said.
Major MBOs during the period included the sports firm Dunlop Slazenger and regional newspaper group Newsquest Media.

Potential economic uncertainty due to elections due by May next year may deter smaller private firms from buy-outs, but KPMG said it expected larger companies will continue to sell off non-core operations.
